'''Spike Squadron''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]]-operated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wing interceptors]]. The squadron was quartered aboard the Airam [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Anat]]''. When the vessel engaged Imperial forces near the [[Blair Cluster/Legends|Blair Cluster]], the squadron participated in the battle that followed, but was wiped out by [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]].
